minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, August 17, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, August 17, 2022.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Scott Snider, Lorraine Missick, and
  Bette Donovan.

  Members absent: Jenny Jolly

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist, Yvonne Duran,
  Community Services Manager and Jesse Cervantes, Community Services
  Coordinator.

  Guest present: Edward Padgett

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, June 15,
  2022 meeting. Motion carried.

  Unfinished Business

2. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, meals were distributed to an
  average of 129 participants per week in June and an average of 140 participants per
  week in July.

  Congregate meals: Meals were served to 19 participants on Tuesday, August 15th.
  Meals will be served every Tuesday and Wednesday for walk-ins until further notice.

  Meals on Wheels: 723 meals were served to 44 La Verne recipients in June. 687
  meals were served to 41 La Verne recipients in July.

3. Guest Speaker: Jesse Cervantes, Community Services Coordinator. Jesse is in
  charge of sports, special events and all senior services. He has been with the City
  for one year and will be working with Amanda.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of June was $4,438.66.
  For the month of July it was $4,030.19. During the first two weeks of August, the
  total amount of checks written was $1,071.19. The breakdown was: $99.00 to the
  City of La Verne, $178.61 to Bingo West, $223.53 to Bingo West, $385.76 to Bingo
  West and $185.00 to the City of La Verne. The total number of players for June, July
   and the first two weeks of August was 386; which is an average attendance of 55
  players per week. The total payouts are currently $1,160 per session.

5. Account Balance: $6,472.83.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid

7. MT. SAC Classes: Fall classes begin next week. This session there will be new
  classes for those with special needs. All classes are listed in the bulletin.

8. Aging Next: 34 La Verne clients were served in May, 36 were served in June, and 32
  were served in July.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: The kitchen renovation at Veterans Hall will be done soon. A new
  skylight will be ordered as well. Preschool will be starting soon.

10. Community Service Application: Senior Advisory Committee applications were
  reviewed and approved. A motion was made and seconded to approve the two
  applicants, Edward Padgett and Rafaela Giles, for the Senior Advisory Committee.
  The motion was carried. The applications will be given to City Council for approval.

11. Upcoming Events:
   Thursday, September 1st: Health and Resource Fair, 9:00-11:00 AM
   Monday, September 5th: Labor Day, Center Closed
   Friday September 16th: Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
   Monday, September 12th: Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
   Wednesday, September 14th: Excursion-1950s Murder Mystery Musical,
  10:15 AM

12. Public Comments: Ed Padgett was visiting and introduced himself. He is a full time
  volunteer and lives in La Verne. He has submitted his application to the Senior
  Advisory Committee.

  Scott gave an update on Hillcrest. They are starting to hold some events and the
  Gallery is now open and has a new display.

  Yvonne provided an update on the City Manager. Jesse Duff will be Interim City
  Manager until further notice.

13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, September 21, 2022 at 10:00 AM.
